description: In this course, a student will complete a project in a mathematical discipline at advanced undergraduate or beginning graduate level under the guidance of his or her supervisor. The topics of the project can involve any applications of pure or applied mathematics in industry, higher-level academic studies, or research works. It provides students opportunities to foster skills on independent mathematical studies. The course culminates in a written report and a project presentation.
preclusion: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN must not have completed 1 of MA4288D/MA4288P at a grade of at least D
preclusionRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN COURSES (1) MA4288D:D, MA4288P:D
title: Undergraduate Project in Mathematics
